svg.title: Automatic final retries, durable saves, partial success and hard exits
svg.desc: A rejected final candidate is excluded by voltage-clock pair. The next eligible tested point is verified automatically. Ordinary exhaustion skips an adaptive tier; critical or backend errors stop probing and preserve completed tiers.

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Selected exact passing curve
Initial choice / duration resolved

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fresh blacklist allows
this voltage / MHz pair?

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Check shape; snapshot; apply / read back
Long Q2RTX + CUDA verification
Custom clocks: own measured reference

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Exclude this pair from retries
Persist observed instability
before post-probe readback

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Save the final verified profile
Exact curve + settings + measurements

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Filter the tested history again
No failed pairs or blacklisted points
Lower MHz or higher V; no MHz increase
Respect custom target limits

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Next best eligible point
E: FPS/W; others: measured clock
No retry dialog

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ordinary tier failure
Adaptive: next tier
Single tier: report failure

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stop all further probes
Critical / backend / persistence error

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 216) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Return completed profiles
Report why probing stopped

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Report the error; no new verified profile

div.style: color: rgb(255, 240, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Exit; no automatic retry
Keep saved profiles / checkpoints
